alinti: terror of all East Anglia, plundering towns so far apart as Norwich and Cambridge
kaynak: T.F. Tout, The Political History of England 1216-1377 (1905); Ch.VI Ely isyani 1266-67 (sayfa ~121-123, OCR basligi yok); archive.org/politicalhistory0000tfto
not: ZAYIF (bolgesel/donemsel; 1280'i dogrudan adlandirmaz): 1267'de Norwich Ingiltere'de, Kralin Ely asilerinin yagma alani; Normandiya fethinden beri Ingiliz; baslangic kaynakta yok.

alinti: He crossed over from Glamorgan, where he had been entertained by Gilbert of Clare, to Bristol, where he held his Christmas court.
kaynak: T.F. Tout, The Political History of England 1216-1377 (1905); s.168 (Edward I, 1284 Noeli); archive.org/politicalhistory0000tfto
not: Edward I 1284'te Bristol'de Noel sarayi kurdu; Tout ayrica 'the burgesses of the second town in England' (1326, s.300).

alinti: in the reign of Edward I. (1281) the 'ville of Sutton' was held by the Prior
kaynak: R.N. Worth, History of Plymouth (1890); s.24; archive.org/historyplymouth00wortgoog
not: 1281'de yer 'Sutton' (Plympton Priory'ye ait kasaba); Plymouth adi 1281 feribot kaydinda su adi ('water of Plimmouth', s.28). Sahip Ingiltere krali altinda Sutton Prior.

alinti: kept Christmas with his overlord at Newcastle, where, on December 26, he did homage to Edward in the castle hall
kaynak: T.F. Tout, The Political History of England 1216-1377 (1905); s.~183 (indeks: Newcastle-upon-Tyne 183; 1292); archive.org/politicalhistory0000tfto
not: 1292 (Balliol'un Edward'a ant icmesi Newcastle kalesinde); ZAYIF (bolgesel/donemsel; 1280'i dogrudan adlandirmaz)

alinti: abandoning Carlisle and performing homage to Henry
kaynak: T.F. Tout, The Political History of England 1216-1377 (1905); s.~15 (indeks: Carlisle 15; 1217); archive.org/politicalhistory0000tfto
not: II. Alexander 1217'de Carlisle'den vazgecti; Carlisle o tarihten beri Ingiliz (Tout: 1307 Carlisle parlamentosu, s.230). Gun/yil kaynak alintisinda yok.

alinti: ceeded to Nottingham, which opened its gates in a panic
kaynak: T.F. Tout, The Political History of England 1216-1377 (1905); s.114 (1264); archive.org/politicalhistory0000tfto
not: ZAYIF (bolgesel/donemsel; 1280'i dogrudan adlandirmaz)

alinti: the bailiffs and commonalty of Liverpool were summoned to appear
kaynak: J.A. Picton, Memorials of Liverpool (1875), cilt 1; s.18 (Quo Warranto, 1292); archive.org/memorialsofliver01pictuoft
not: Kral Yohanna 28 Agustos 1207'de Liverpool'u Henry Fitzwarine ile degisim yoluyla mulkune gecirdi (s.9-10: 'On the 28th of the following August (1207) he formally entered ... into possession of Liverpool'); 1292'de 'bailiffs and commonalty' = kasaba var.
alinti_2: On the 28th of the following August (1207) he formally entered
kaynak_2: J.A. Picton, Memorials of Liverpool (1875), cilt 1; s.9-10; archive.org/memorialsofliver01pictuoft

alinti: The manor of Birmingham, therefore, valued at forty pounds per annum, was seized by the King, and given to his favourite, Roger de Clifford.
kaynak: W. Hutton, History of Birmingham (1839 bas.); s.150 (1265); archive.org/historyofbirming00hutt
not: ZAYIF (bolgesel/donemsel; 1280'i dogrudan adlandirmaz): 1265'te kral malikanesine el koydu, Statute of Kenilworth (1266) ile William de Birmingham fidye odedi; 1280'de William de Birmingham'in elinde olduguna dair dogrudan satir okunmadi.

alinti: by which the town, under its occasional name of Wyke-upon-Hull, became royal property
kaynak: J. Frost, Notices relative to the early history of the town and port of Hull (1827); s.~18 (OCR; 1293 Meaux degisimi); archive.org/noticesrelative00frosgoog
not: 1280'de yer 'Hul/Wyke' adiyla var, Meaux (Melsa) manastirina ait (Ingiltere'de); Edward I 1293'te degisimle krala gecirdi ('Kingston'). Kral kasabasi olarak baslangic 1293 (yil). Kaynak 1280'de ticaret limani var diyor.
alinti_2: Such was the state of Commerce in the Port of Hull immediately preceding the year 1293
kaynak_2: J. Frost, Notices relative to the early history of the town and port of Hull (1827); s.~18; archive.org/noticesrelative00frosgoog

alinti: Edward summoned for Michaelmas at Shrewsbury a parliament whose chief business was the trial of David
kaynak: T.F. Tout, The Political History of England 1216-1377 (1905); s.165 (1283); archive.org/politicalhistory0000tfto
not: 1283'te Edward I Shrewsbury'de parlamento topladi.

alinti: This is the first appearance of Penzance in authentic history.
kaynak: Lach-Szyrma, A short history of Penzance (1878); s.79 (1332 Alverton pazar fermani); archive.org/ashorthistorype00lachgoog
not: Yazara gore Penzance'in tarih belgesine ilk girisi 1332 (Edward III pazar+fuar). 1284'te Alverton malikanesi (Henry le Tyes) var, Penzance adi yok. Alan Ingiltere'de.

alinti: Flint and Rhuddlan dominated the two former, Aber- ystwyth and Carmarthen the latter.
kaynak: T.F. Tout, The Political History of England 1216-1377 (1905); s.160 (1277 sonrasi duzen; s.158 Cardiganshire fethi); archive.org/politicalhistory0000tfto
not: 1277 Aberconwy sonrasi Edward kraliyet kalesi/kasabasi; Lloyd 1282 isyaninda 'royal castles of Aberystwyth' diyor (s.~762, OCR '7^2'). Gwynedd degil.
alinti_2: the chieftains of the South attacked the royal castles of Aberystwyth, Llandovery, and Carreg Cennen
kaynak_2: J.E. Lloyd, A History of Wales to the Edwardian Conquest (1911), cilt 2; s.~762 (OCR); archive.org/historyofwalesfr02lloyuoft

alinti: In Uriel or Louth the castle of Dundalk was restored to Nicholas de Yerdun
kaynak: G.H. Orpen, Ireland under the Normans 1216-1333, cilt 3; s.20 (1217-18); archive.org/irelandundernorm03orpe
not: ZAYIF (bolgesel/donemsel; 1280'i dogrudan adlandirmaz): Anglo-Norman Louth/Verdun lordlugu; Orpen4 s.~? Bruce 1315'te 'town of Dundalk'u yakti.

alinti: in August 1220 an arrange- ment was made by which the castle and vill of Drogheda
kaynak: G.H. Orpen, Ireland under the Normans 1216-1333, cilt 3; s.20; archive.org/irelandundernorm03orpe
not: Agustos 1220 duzenlemesi: kale ve 'vill' kralda kalir; Walter de Lacy 1194'te Drogheda burgess'lerine Breteuil hukuku vermisti (s.20 dipnot).

alinti: the services of Mullingar and some other manors in the eastern baronies of Westmeath were assigned to the de Geynville moiety
kaynak: G.H. Orpen, Ireland under the Normans 1216-1333, cilt 3; s.~(Meath bolusme bolumu; OCR basligi yok); archive.org/irelandundernorm03orpe
not: ZAYIF (bolgesel/donemsel; 1280'i dogrudan adlandirmaz): Mullingar cevresi de Lacy feoffee'si (William le Petit) malikanesi; 1280 tarihi dogrudan degil.

sahip_1280: belirsiz: O'Brien (Thomond) / Thomas de Clare (1276 kral bagisi)
alinti: In 1270 he turned against the Enghsh and took the castle of Clare near Ennis
kaynak: G.H. Orpen, Ireland under the Normans 1216-1333, cilt 4; s.64-65; archive.org/irelandundernorm04orpe
not: Brian Roe O'Brien 1270'te Clare kalesini aldi; 1276'da Thomas de Clare'e Thomond verildi ama fiilen anarsi; Ennis'te 'town' degil Clonroad ve Fransisken manastiri (s.64). 1280 sahibi kaynakta tek anlamli degil.

alinti: is believed to have been first granted to a de Barry, who has left his name in Castlebar
kaynak: G.H. Orpen, Ireland under the Normans 1216-1333, cilt 3; s.216; archive.org/irelandundernorm03orpe
not: Carra baronluk Anglo-Norman enfeoffment (tarihsiz); 1333 oncesi sahibi de Cogan; 1280 kalesi/kasabasi icin tarih yok. Yer varligi 1280 icin bulunamadi.

alinti: Aedh retaliated by plundering and burning the English homesteads between Balla and Slieve Lugha, and also in the district between Tuam and Athlone
kaynak: G.H. Orpen, Ireland under the Normans 1216-1333, cilt 3; s.~(1262; OCR sayfa basligi yok); archive.org/irelandundernorm03orpe
not: 1262'de bolge Ingiliz yerlesimi ile Gaelik krallik arasinda catisma halinde; 1280 icin dogrudan satir yok. Tuam arkepiskoposluk merkezi (1152).

alinti: Mac Mahon, chieftain of Irish Uriel
kaynak: G.H. Orpen, Ireland under the Normans 1216-1333, cilt 4; s.140 (1283); archive.org/irelandundernorm04orpe
not: ZAYIF (bolgesel/donemsel; 1280'i dogrudan adlandirmaz): Monaghan adi gecmez, 'Co. Monaghan' (Farney) s.166. Yerlesim 1280 icin bulunamadi.

alinti: viz. O'Hanlon's country in County Armagh, and O'Neill's own territory in County Tyrone
kaynak: G.H. Orpen, Ireland under the Normans 1216-1333, cilt 4; s.168 (1315); archive.org/irelandundernorm04orpe
not: ZAYIF (bolgesel/donemsel; 1280'i dogrudan adlandirmaz): Ulster Kontlugu 'east of the Bann, Lough Neagh, and the Newry River' (s.168); Armagh bu sinirin disinda; 1315 kaynagi, 1280 icin cikarim.
alinti_2: Ulster at this time was the district east of the Bann, Lough Neagh, and the Newry Eiver
kaynak_2: G.H. Orpen, Ireland under the Normans 1216-1333, cilt 4; s.168; archive.org/irelandundernorm04orpe

alinti: Against the west it is bounded by the Newry River, Lough Neagh, and the Lower Bann
kaynak: G.H. Orpen, Ireland under the Normans 1216-1333, cilt 4; s.133; archive.org/irelandundernorm04orpe
not: Crown Rath Newry yakininda Anglo-Norman hendek; Newry sinir uzerinde; kasaba 1280 icin bulunamadi.

alinti: Alexander held a council in the castle of Edinburgh
kaynak: P. Hume Brown, History of Scotland, cilt 1; s.~(1286 Mart; Alexander III olumu, 'Book ii'); archive.org/historyofscotlan01brow
not: 1286 Alexander III Edinburgh kalesinde konsey; 1296 bitisi kaynaktan okunmadi (Brown I 'Edward I takes Berwick' s.143).

alinti: Three years later (July, 1266) the Western Islands were definitively united to the Crown of Scotland.
kaynak: P. Hume Brown, History of Scotland, cilt 1; s.126; archive.org/historyofscotlan01brow
not: Brown: 'The Isle of Man was included in the treaty; but at a later period Alexander had once more to make good his claim to it by the strong hand' (1275 Ronaldsway, kaynak yil vermiyor). Gun yok (kunye 1266-07-02 ayri kaynak). Douglas yerlesimi 1280 icin ARANMADI/bulunamadi.
alinti_2: The Isle of Man was included in the treaty
kaynak_2: P. Hume Brown, History of Scotland, cilt 1; s.126; archive.org/historyofscotlan01brow

alinti: the association of the Four Burghs, which originally consisted of Berwick, Roxburgh, Edinburgh, and Stirling
kaynak: P. Hume Brown, History of Scotland, cilt 1; s.~102 (William the Lion; 1296 alinti ayri); archive.org/historyofscotlan01brow
not: Berwick Iskoc burg'u (Four Burghs); 1296'da Edward I aldi (Brown s.143 icindekiler).

alinti: Wishart, Bishop of Glasgow, and Comyn, Lord of Badenoch
kaynak: P. Hume Brown, History of Scotland, cilt 1; s.134 (1290 komisyonu); archive.org/historyofscotlan01brow
not: ZAYIF (bolgesel/donemsel; 1280'i dogrudan adlandirmaz): 1290'lar Iskocya vasi; Glasgow piskoposluguna ait David I kaydi (s.~95).

alinti: Edinburgh, Stirling, Inverkeithing, Perth, and Aberdeen
kaynak: P. Hume Brown, History of Scotland, cilt 1; s.~63 (I. Alexander donemi); archive.org/historyofscotlan01brow
not: ZAYIF (bolgesel/donemsel; 1280'i dogrudan adlandirmaz): 12. yy Iskoc kralinin baslica kasabalarindan; 1280 icin dogrudan satir yok.

alinti: Perth, Inverness, and Ayr, all possess charters from William
kaynak: P. Hume Brown, History of Scotland, cilt 1; s.~104 (William the Lion, 1165-1214); archive.org/historyofscotlan01brow
not: ZAYIF (bolgesel/donemsel; 1280'i dogrudan adlandirmaz)

alinti: At a great Council in Perth he told the assembled clergy that they must either pay a tithe on all their benefices
kaynak: P. Hume Brown, History of Scotland, cilt 1; s.~128 (III. Alexander, 1274); archive.org/historyofscotlan01brow
not: III. Alexander donemi Perth'te buyuk konsey (kaynak yil vermiyor).

alinti: presenting himself at the town of Dumfries, he agreed to accept Alexander as his liege lord
kaynak: P. Hume Brown, History of Scotland, cilt 1; s.126 (1264); archive.org/historyofscotlan01brow
not: Man krali Magnus'un III. Alexander'a Dumfries'te ant icmesi.

alinti: the title of Caithness passed to the house of Angus about 1232
kaynak: J. Mackay, History of the Province of Cat (Caithness and Sutherland) (1914); s.82; archive.org/historyofprovinc00mackuoft
not: Caithness 1232 sonrasi Angus ailesine gecen Iskoc kontlugu (s.74); Wick'in 1280 varligi kaynakta bulunamadi (kaynaktaki Wick anmalari 16. yy). Alinti yok.

alinti: Three years later (July, 1266) the Western Islands were definitively united to the Crown of Scotland.
kaynak: P. Hume Brown, History of Scotland, cilt 1; s.126; archive.org/historyofscotlan01brow
not: Hebridler 1266'da Iskocya'ya; Lewis'te Stornoway 1280 yerlesim kaydi bulunamadi (Brown yalniz 1501'de 'island of Lewis').

alinti: Lerwick seems to have been first built about the beginning of the 17th century
kaynak: S. Hibbert, A Description of the Shetland Islands (1822); s.107; archive.org/descriptionofshe00hibbrich
not: Shetland 1280'de Norvec'e bagli Orkney Kontlugu bolgesi; Brown I: 'The Orkney and Shetland Islands were not acquired by Scotland till 1468.'
alinti_2: The Orkney and Shetland Islands were not acquired by Scotland till 1468.
kaynak_2: P. Hume Brown, History of Scotland, cilt 1; dipnot s.~30; archive.org/historyofscotlan01brow
